mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the diaphragm was most worthwhile: the planned paired views connect its movement to inhalation and elastic recoil during exhalation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the pleural membranes alone was a predictable intermediate step; its picture plan showed their arrangement but did not yet explain how the interface couples lung and chest movement.

surprise.text: The final result clarified that the lungs are pulled outward through the pleural interface rather than directly by the diaphragm.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the empty breathing-muscle slot made the final choice essentially automatic.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see more structure-to-function connections, provided they offer more meaningful choices than this short, largely predictable sequence.
